title: read.cv – Professional Profiles
description: Read.cv is a minimal, typography-centric professional network page. Uses a clean white background with serif headings — an unusual choice for a tech product that creates an editorial, thoughtful feel. Centered layout with generous whitespace makes the page feel unhurried and premium. Clean card-based profile previews show how the platform works. Understated design that lets content shine. No heavy animations or flashy elements — pure typographic elegance. The design philosophy is confidence through restraint: the page trusts that good typography and content hierarchy are enough. A fresh alternative to the standard social network landing page template.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for professional networks, portfolio platforms, and content-first products that want an understated, typography-driven page.
style_vibe: Minimal, typography-driven professional network with serif headings, generous whitespace, and an editorial, unhurried feel.
